metadata.description: Profanity Creative's agent team plugins. Source of truth; edited in Dropbox plugin-dev and pushed nightly.

plugins.name: profanity-willa
plugins.description: Willa Prescott, EP for Profanity Creative. Mark's right hand: takes any ask, routes it to the right agent, runs the chain end to end and hands back one package. Never does the specialist work herself.

plugins.name: profanity-lyle
plugins.description: Lyle Whitlock, legal for Profanity Creative. Runs Anthropic's Legal plugin against Profanity's own playbook: client contract review, NDA triage, and upkeep of the studio's T&C and SOW terms. Preps the call; an attorney makes it.

plugins.name: profanity-james
plugins.description: Finance & bookkeeping operator for Profanity Creative — meet James Halloran. Pulls from QuickBooks to track project profitability, categorize expenses, monitor cash flow, watch 1099 contractor spend, and pack up clean materials for the CPA. Reads the books, flags risk, never gives tax advice.

plugins.name: profanity-sloane
plugins.description: Virtual Producer for Profanity Creative — handles proposals, scoping, client communication, project documentation, post-mortems, and quick call/update logging so Mark can stay in the creative.

plugins.name: profanity-reid
plugins.description: Reid Calloway (Biz Dev) + Deck Builder for Profanity Creative. Helps Mark find, approach, and close the right clients in outdoor, lifestyle, and action sports — and build presentation decks in Profanity's signature dark, minimal style.

plugins.name: profanity-kai
plugins.description: Virtual Creative Director for Profanity Creative — concept development, moodboard direction, style frames, and animation treatments for 3D product visualization.

plugins.name: profanity-dusty
plugins.description: Dusty Jones — in-house copywriter for Profanity Creative. Studio copy, long-form content, client brand copy, voice editing, and SEO optimization.

plugins.name: profanity-nora
plugins.description: Nora Beckett — Social Media Manager for Profanity Creative. Post creation, content planning, project launches, and growth strategy for Instagram and LinkedIn.

plugins.name: profanity-it
plugins.description: Virtual IT and web resource for Profanity Creative — Framer, GitHub, Netlify, Notion, and Cowork plugin support

plugins.name: profanity-workflows
plugins.description: Automated workflow chains for Profanity Creative — run full agent pipelines with a single command. Content Engine and Post-Mortem Pipeline.
